prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) filesystem_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [archive_members]: Before extracting an archive, validate every member name and link target against the destination directory, and reject device files or other special entries that the application does not require.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 153 and 184 Kimi tokens; aim for 168 tokens to match the source. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: Untrusted `filename` string and approved `reports_root` path.
TRUST: Trust only the approved root boundary; treat `filename` as potentially malicious traversal or symlink attack.
SINK: UTF-8 text read of the resolved ordinary file beneath `reports_root`.
GUARD: Symbolic links may be followed only after resolving the complete target path and confirming that the resolved target remains inside the approved root; reject escape with ValueError.
ORDER: Join `reports_root` and `filename`; resolve the complete target path including symbolic links; verify the resolved target remains inside `reports_root`; open and read UTF-8 contents.
EFFECT: Return file contents as `str`; propagate `FileNotFoundError` for a missing ordinary file; raise `ValueError` when path resolution leaves the approved root.
END_PLAN
